[LCST.4.1.1] **Form.** A conversion is a postfix operator, `'::' TYPE_SYM
NULLABLE?`, in the same left-to-right `postfix_op*` chain that carries member
access, method calls, and indexing ([LGRA.9.6.1]). So `::` composes with `.`, a
method call, and `[…]` in one chain evaluated left to right; it is **not** a
separate precedence level above member access. `R.v::Int.bit_count` is
therefore `(R.v::Int).bit_count` ([LCST.4.1.4]) — `::Int` and `.bit_count`
are adjacent postfix operators on the same primary.
